symptom: I need hardware PWM for a dimmable LED. I set up PWM on BCM17 but the output is software-timed and jitters under load — not a clean hardware clock.

files.fade.py:
import RPi.GPIO as GPIO
GPIO.setmode(GPIO.BCM)
GPIO.setup(17, GPIO.OUT)
pwm = GPIO.PWM(17, 1000)
pwm.start(50)

gold.diagnosis: On the Pi, hardware PWM (channel 0) is available only on BCM GPIO12/GPIO18 (the PCM_CLK/PWM0 pins), not BCM17. GPIO.PWM(17) is always software bit-banged. Move the LED to BCM12 and use a hardware-backed PWM source (gpiozero PWMLED on BCM12, which uses lgpio's hardware-timed PWM on Pi 5).
